recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. FHIR-14155 should not be reopened because later final decisions explain the current placement and scope of the terminology; any future generated-diagram cleanup or core/THO duplication cleanup should be handled under the later THO/binding issues instead.
issue_request: FHIR-14155 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 and requested that ResearchStudyStatus use the vetted SME value set; the resolution states that the change was made and published in the December 2017 FHIR ballot.
initial_application: Three explicit GF#14155 commits applied the change: 31ac7a2 updated the ResearchStudy spreadsheet and example from the old draft/in-progress/suspended/stopped/completed/entered-in-error set to the vetted status codes, and 0979e21 plus 30b741 updated source/status-codes.xml and corrected administratively-completed spelling.
additional_context: Later final decisions intentionally changed the current model. ResearchStudy.status is now the resource publication status, while ResearchStudy.progressStatus.state carries the study conduct/progress status binding. FHIR-32314 added ClinicalTrials.gov codes, FHIR-33096 corrected the completed definition and binding strength, UP-758 moved Research Study Status terminology toward THO, FHIR-53697 changed progressStatus.state to Preferred binding to the THO value set, and FHIR-50644 confirms ResearchStudy.status is not study status.
reconciliation: No source change was made. ResearchStudy is active in source/fhir.ini, the current ResearchStudy CodeSystem/ValueSet source contains the vetted code family plus later approved additions, and source/researchstudy/structuredefinition-ResearchStudy.xml binds ResearchStudy.progressStatus.state to http://terminology.hl7.org/ValueSet/research-study-status with Preferred strength while ResearchStudy.status correctly uses publication-status.
